name: Public Safety Advisory Board Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  PUBLIC SAFETY ADVISORY BOARD
  Westlake Village City Hall
  Large Community Meeting Room
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village

  TUESDAY, JUNE 6, 2023, at 6:00 p.m.

Written Public Comments on agenda items may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at
antoinette@wlv.org no later than 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be
provided to the Public Safety Advisory Board.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Advisory Board Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting
are available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal  business  hours  and  are  posted  on  the  City’s  Website
https://www.wlv.org/660/8208/Advisory-Boards-and-Committees-Supplemen

CALL TO ORDER: 6:00 pm

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Pearl, Councilmember Halpern

  Members of the Public Safety Advisory Board:
  Tisha Banker, Ted Corwin, Stephen Johnson, Karen Kimmel,
  Susan MacLean, Scott Perrotty, and Shirley Richards

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may offer comment only in person at this meeting or by
sending an email comment as instructed on page 1 of this Agenda.
 BUSINESS:

1.  City Sidewalk Master Plan Overview – Staff will present an overview of the
  sidewalk master plan project.

2.  Staff Updates:

  a. Public Safety Advisory Board Recruitment
  b. Pedestrian Safety Educational Graphic and Slogan

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 1, 2023, at 2:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less than
 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-
 Supplemental-Packets https://www.wlv.org/660/8208/Advisory-Boards-and-Committees-Supplemen
